newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 9,200 MT were 86 percent less than the prior week and 82 percent below the 4-week average. Major increases for Indonesia (60,000 MT, switched from unknown), Japan (52,900 MT), Mexico (47,400 MT), and Malaysia (25,000 MT) were partially offset by reductions for Taiwan (84,700 MT), unknown destinations (60,000 MT), and Trinidad (27,000 MT).

Sales of 432,200 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were mainly for China (195,000 MT, including switches of 100,000 MT from unknown), unknown destinations (75,500 MT), the Netherlands (61,700 MT), and Indonesia (60,000 MT).

Exports of 260,800 MT were 5 percent above the previous week and 4 percent above the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Mexico (70,600 MT), Indonesia (60,000 MT), Japan (42,200 MT), and South Korea (38,500 MT).
